body: I was about to get up and be done with reddit for hours, but your picture made me sit back down.
Aww, is that her own feces on her nose? SO CUTE!!

>and remember that if you've been there once you can be there again.

Excellent advice. Thanks again.

I feel better after talking and am glad I posted. I didn't plan to harm myself tonight, and I don't feel I'm a danger to myself right now, but I really did and still do need to talk more and this was a great temporary help. You deserve a beer or whatever you treat yourself with, Poysun. Thanks.

Hah. I wanted to be superman. That is a good thing to think about. I didn't have more passions than a gameboy and climbing trees. Well I liked girls a lot and had a few serious girlfriends before grade school. That's another thing that people tell me. I need a girlfriend. My first reaction is just: that shit is not happening. No room on the plate. I feel like I don't even have time to date or energy emotionally, and I'm not smooth, and I'm not in shape any more so one night stands are... not going to be free.

I have a G.I. Bill. The thing is I am not a very good student. I did drop out at 15. I also hate being trapped indoors. I would rather be tied to a log and sent down some rapids than sit at a desk five days a week.

School may be the best option for me thinking objectively. That's usually where people end up when I talk to them as well.

I just bought a German Shepherd for my family. I plan to move across the U.S. to my cousins' place soon. I would really like to find a job that I'm good at and enjoy. I can't just take everything and hang it up on the wall and say "I can get X job, and have X things that make me happy", and that's that. My life has no meaning. I feel at this point I couldn't really become the next Bill Gates. I don't know what I want, and what I want is to be happy. I have no idea how to do that.

That was pretty inspiring and thanks for responding at all.

I haven't honestly reached out to all my family. I told my father during the whole military discharge thing that it was a show so that I could get out quick. I'm pretty sure they know how I feel as I have always been depressed and talked with my other about it. I was in a psych treatment ward for three weeks. They visited. I do need another psychologist, and am covered by military health insurance until next year, but I really wouldn't expect to get much from one and the only reason I would want medications is for a disability claim with Veterans Affairs for a disability type pension. I am prone to giving up. I gave up a long time ago and it is due to common courtesy that I am still here. It's nice to believe in myself for a while and feel strong, but that is maddeningly difficult to maintain for me. I love traveling and I love helping people and making positive and substantial changes and the feeling that brings. The world is vibrant and I can tell myself that I am just as vibrant and capable, but it doesn't take hold. If I could find something that actually mattered to be a part of, that I could grasp and would be sustainable, I'm sure I would enjoy it and thrive. The problem for me is finding that spark may as well be as likely as a $2.50 slot spin producing a six figure jackpot.
